passages.text: Now these are the priests and Levites who went up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra, Amariah, Malluch, Hattush, Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth, Iddo, Ginnethon, Abijah, Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah, Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah, Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These were the leaders of the priests and their associates in the days of Jeshua.
passages.sermon:
The priests and Levites went up from Babylon.
Zerubbabel led them.
Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel.
Jeshua went with them.
These are the names of the priests and Levites who went:
Seraiah.
Jeremiah.
Ezra.
Amariah.
Malluch.
Hattush.
Shecaniah.
Rehum.
Meremoth.
Iddo.
Ginnethon.
Abijah.
Mijamin.
Maadiah.
Bilgah.
Shemaiah.
Joiarib.
Jedaiah.
Sallu.
Amok.
Hilkiah.
Jedaiah.
These men were the leaders of the priests.
Their associates served with them.
They lived and served in the days of Jeshua.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָל֛וּ עִם־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל בֶּן־ שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל וְיֵשׁ֑וּעַ שְׂרָיָ֥ה יִרְמְיָ֖ה עֶזְרָֽא׃ אֲמַרְיָ֥ה מַלּ֖וּךְ חַטּֽוּשׁ׃ שְׁכַנְיָ֥ה רְחֻ֖ם מְרֵמֹֽת׃ עִדּ֥וֹא גִנְּת֖וֹי אֲבִיָּֽה׃ מִיָּמִ֥ין מַֽעַדְיָ֖ה בִּלְגָּֽה׃ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה וְיוֹיָרִ֖יב יְדַֽעְיָֽה׃ סַלּ֣וּ עָמ֔וֹק חִלְקִיָּ֖ה יְדַֽעְיָ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֧י הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם בִּימֵ֥י יֵשֽׁוּעַ׃פ

passages.text: The Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who, with his associates, led the songs of thanksgiving.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were leaders among the people of Israel.
Their names were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah.
Mattaniah and his associates led the songs of thanksgiving.
These Levites gave thanks to God through music.
They worked together as a group.
passages.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֗ם יֵשׁ֧וּעַ בִּנּ֛וּי קַדְמִיאֵ֥ל שֵׁרֵבְיָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֣ה מַתַּנְיָ֑ה עַֽל־ הֻיְּד֖וֹת ה֥וּא וְאֶחָֽיו׃

passages.text: Bakbukiah and Unni, their associates, stood across from them in the services.
passages.sermon:
Bakbukiah was a Levite.
Unni was a Levite.
Their associates were Levites.
Bakbukiah, Unni, and their associates stood opposite the singers.
They stood across from the singers during the services.
They served as part of the worship duties.
passages.original: וּבַקְבֻּֽקְיָ֨ה וְעֻנּוֹ אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם לְנֶגְדָּ֖ם לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Jeshua was the father of Joiakim, Joiakim was the father of Eliashib, Eliashib was the father of Joiada, Joiada was the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan was the father of Jaddua.
passages.sermon:
Jeshua was a Levite leader.
Jeshua was the father of Joiakim.
Joiakim was the father of Eliashib.
Eliashib was the father of Joiada.
Joiada was the father of Jonathan.
Jonathan was the father of Jaddua.
passages.original: וְיֵשׁ֖וּעַ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יֽוֹיָקִ֑ים וְיֽוֹיָקִים֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב וְאֶלְיָשִׁ֖יב אֶת־ יוֹיָדָֽע׃ וְיוֹיָדָע֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יוֹנָתָ֔ן וְיוֹנָתָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ יַדּֽוּעַ׃

passages.text: In the days of Joiakim, these were the heads of the priestly families: of the family of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah; of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan; of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph; of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai; of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam; of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin and of Moadiah, Piltai; of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jonathan; of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi; of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber; of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; and of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
passages.sermon:
Joiakim was a high priest in Jerusalem.
He lived after the return from exile.
During Joiakim’s days, each priestly family had a leader.
Meraiah led the family of Seraiah.
Hananiah led the family of Jeremiah.
Meshullam led the family of Ezra.
Jehohanan led the family of Amariah.
Jonathan led the family of Malluchi.
Joseph led the family of Shebaniah.
Adna led the family of Harim.
Helkai led the family of Meraioth.
Zechariah led the family of Iddo.
Meshullam led the family of Ginnethon.
Zichri led the family of Abijah.
Piltai led the families of Miniamin and Moadiah.
Shammua led the family of Bilgah.
Jonathan led the family of Shemaiah.
Mattenai led the family of Joiarib.
Uzzi led the family of Jedaiah.
Kallai led the family of Sallai.
Eber led the family of Amok.
Hashabiah led the family of Hilkiah.
Nethanel led the family of Jedaiah.
passages.original: וּבִימֵי֙ יֽוֹיָקִ֔ים הָי֥וּ כֹהֲנִ֖ים רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֑וֹת לִשְׂרָיָ֣ה מְרָיָ֔ה לְיִרְמְיָ֖ה חֲנַנְיָֽה׃ לְעֶזְרָ֣א מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם לַאֲמַרְיָ֖ה יְהוֹחָנָֽן׃ לִמְלוּכִי יֽוֹנָתָ֔ן לִשְׁבַנְיָ֖ה יוֹסֵֽף׃ לְחָרִ֣ם עַדְנָ֔א לִמְרָי֖וֹת חֶלְקָֽי׃ לַעֲדָיָא זְכַרְיָ֖ה לְגִנְּת֥וֹן מְשֻׁלָּֽם׃ לַאֲבִיָּ֖ה זִכְרִ֑י לְמִ֨נְיָמִ֔ין לְמוֹעַדְיָ֖ה פִּלְטָֽי׃ לְבִלְגָּ֣ה שַׁמּ֔וּעַ לִֽשְׁמַעְיָ֖ה יְהוֹנָתָֽן׃ וּלְיוֹיָרִ֣יב מַתְּנַ֔י לִֽידַֽעְיָ֖ה עֻזִּֽי׃ לְסַלַּ֥י קַלָּ֖י לְעָמ֥וֹק עֵֽבֶר׃ לְחִלְקִיָּ֣ה חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה לִֽידַֽעְיָ֖ה נְתַנְאֵֽל׃

passages.text: In the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, during the reign of Darius the Persian, the heads of the families of the Levites and priests were recorded.
passages.sermon:
Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua were leaders in Israel.
Darius the Persian was king during their time.
People recorded the heads of the families of the Levites.
People also recorded the heads of the families of the priests.
They made these records in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua.
They did this while Darius the Persian ruled.
passages.original: הַלְוִיִּם֩ בִּימֵ֨י אֶלְיָשִׁ֜יב יוֹיָדָ֤ע וְיוֹחָנָן֙ וְיַדּ֔וּעַ כְּתוּבִ֖ים רָאשֵׁ֣י אָב֑וֹת וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים עַל־ מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ הַפָּֽרְסִֽי׃פ

passages.text: As for the descendants of Levi, the family heads up to the days of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the Book of the Chronicles.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Levi were a tribe in Israel.
The heads of their families were important leaders.
People wrote the names of these family heads in the Book of the Chronicles.
They recorded these names up to the days of Johanan.
Johanan was the son of Eliashib.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֤י לֵוִי֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֔וֹת כְּתוּבִ֕ים עַל־ סֵ֖פֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י הַיָּמִ֑ים וְעַד־ יְמֵ֖י יֽוֹחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃

passages.text: The leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua son of Kadmiel, along with their associates, who stood across from them to give praise and thanksgiving as one section alternated with the other, as prescribed by David the man of God.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a special group in Israel.
They served God in the temple.
The leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua son of Kadmiel.
These leaders had associates who worked with them.
The associates stood across from the leaders.
They gave praise to God.
They gave thanks to God.
They did this as one group answered the other group.
David, the man of God, gave this command.
The Levites followed David’s instructions.
passages.original: וְרָאשֵׁ֣י הַ֠לְוִיִּם חֲשַׁבְיָ֨ה שֵֽׁרֵבְיָ֜ה וְיֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־ קַדְמִיאֵל֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֣ם לְנֶגְדָּ֔ם לְהַלֵּ֣ל לְהוֹד֔וֹת בְּמִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֣יד אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר׃

passages.text: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers who guarded the storerooms at the gates.
passages.sermon:
Mattaniah was a gatekeeper.
Bakbukiah was a gatekeeper.
Obadiah was a gatekeeper.
Meshullam was a gatekeeper.
Talmon was a gatekeeper.
Akkub was a gatekeeper.
These men guarded the storerooms at the gates.
passages.original: מַתַּנְיָ֧ה וּבַקְבֻּֽקְיָ֛ה עֹבַדְיָ֥ה מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם טַלְמ֣וֹן עַקּ֑וּב שֹׁמְרִ֤ים שֽׁוֹעֲרִים֙ מִשְׁמָ֔ר בַּאֲסֻפֵּ֖י הַשְּׁעָרִֽים׃

passages.text: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest and scribe.
passages.sermon:
Joiakim was the son of Jeshua.
Jeshua was the son of Jozadak.
Nehemiah was the governor.
Ezra was the priest and scribe.
These leaders and their associates served during the days of Joiakim, Nehemiah, and Ezra.
passages.original: אֵ֕לֶּה בִּימֵ֛י יוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־ יֵשׁ֖וּעַ בֶּן־ יוֹצָדָ֑ק וּבִימֵי֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה הַפֶּחָ֔ה וְעֶזְרָ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַסּוֹפֵֽר׃פ

passages.text: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from all their homes and brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the joyous dedication with thanksgiving and singing, accompanied by cymbals, harps, and lyres.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were men from the tribe of Levi.
People searched for the Levites in all their homes.
They brought the Levites to Jerusalem.
They came for the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.
They gathered to celebrate the dedication.
They celebrated with joy.
They gave thanks.
They sang songs.
They played cymbals.
They played harps.
They played lyres.
passages.original: וּבַחֲנֻכַּ֞ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם בִּקְשׁ֤וּ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִכָּל־ מְק֣וֹמֹתָ֔ם לַהֲבִיאָ֖ם לִֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשֹׂ֨ת חֲנֻכָּ֤ה וְשִׂמְחָה֙ וּבְתוֹד֣וֹת וּבְשִׁ֔יר מְצִלְתַּ֖יִם נְבָלִ֥ים וּבְכִנֹּרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The singers were also assembled from the region around Jerusalem, from the villages of the Netophathites, from Beth-gilgal, and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for they had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The singers gathered together.
They came from the area around Jerusalem.
Some singers came from the villages of the Netophathites.
Some singers came from Beth-gilgal.
Some singers came from the fields of Geba.
Some singers came from the fields of Azmaveth.
The singers had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.
They lived in these villages near Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיֵּאָ֣סְפ֔וּ בְּנֵ֖י הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים וּמִן־ הַכִּכָּר֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּמִן־ חַצְרֵ֖י נְטֹפָתִֽי׃ וּמִבֵּית֙ הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל וּמִשְּׂד֥וֹת גֶּ֖בַע וְעַזְמָ֑וֶת כִּ֣י חֲצֵרִ֗ים בָּנ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רֲרִ֔ים סְבִיב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: After the priests and Levites had purified themselves, they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
passages.sermon:
The priests and the Levites served God in Jerusalem.
The priests purified themselves.
The Levites purified themselves.
The priests and Levites purified the people.
The priests and Levites purified the gates.
The priests and Levites purified the wall.
passages.original: וַיִּֽטַּהֲר֔וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַֽיְטַהֲרוּ֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁעָרִ֖ים וְאֶֽת־ הַחוֹמָֽה׃

passages.text: Then I brought the leaders of Judah up on the wall, and I appointed two great thanksgiving choirs. One was to proceed along the top of the wall to the right, toward the Dung Gate.
passages.sermon:
I brought the leaders of Judah up onto the wall.
I appointed two large thanksgiving choirs.
One choir went to the right along the top of the wall.
They went toward the Dung Gate.
passages.original: וָאַעֲלֶה֙ אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל לַחוֹמָ֑ה וָאַעֲמִ֡ידָה שְׁתֵּ֣י תוֹדֹת֩ גְּדוֹלֹ֨ת וְתַהֲלֻכֹ֤ת לַיָּמִין֙ מֵעַ֣ל לַחוֹמָ֔ה לְשַׁ֖עַר הָאַשְׁפֹּֽת׃

passages.text: Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah followed, along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam, Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah, and some of the priests with trumpets, and also Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph, and his associates—Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani—with the musical instruments prescribed by David the man of God. Ezra the scribe led the procession.
passages.sermon:
Hoshaiah followed the procession.
Half the leaders of Judah followed with him.
Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam also followed.
Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah were with them.
Some priests carried trumpets.
Zechariah was among the priests.
Zechariah was the son of Jonathan.
Jonathan was the son of Shemaiah.
Shemaiah was the son of Mattaniah.
Mattaniah was the son of Micaiah.
Micaiah was the son of Zaccur.
Zaccur was the son of Asaph.
Zechariah had associates with him.
Their names were Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani.
They played musical instruments.
David, the man of God, had prescribed these instruments.
Ezra was a scribe.
Ezra led the procession.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙ הוֹשַׁ֣עְיָ֔ה וַחֲצִ֖י שָׂרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃ וַעֲזַרְיָ֥ה עֶזְרָ֖א וּמְשֻׁלָּֽם׃ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֖ה וְיִרְמְיָֽה׃ס וּמִבְּנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת זְכַרְיָ֨ה בֶן־ יֽוֹנָתָ֜ן בֶּן־ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה בֶּן־ מַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־ מִ֣יכָיָ֔ה בֶּן־ זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־ אָסָֽף׃ וְֽאֶחָ֡יו שְֽׁמַעְיָ֡ה וַעֲזַרְאֵ֡ל מִֽלֲלַ֡י גִּֽלֲלַ֡י מָעַ֞י נְתַנְאֵ֤ל וִֽיהוּדָה֙ חֲנָ֔נִי בִּכְלֵי־ שִׁ֥יר דָּוִ֖יד אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעֶזְרָ֥א הַסּוֹפֵ֖ר לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: At the Fountain Gate they climbed the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall and passed above the house of David to the Water Gate on the east.
passages.sermon:
The people reached the Fountain Gate.
They climbed the steps of the City of David.
They went up on the ascent to the wall.
They passed above the house of David.
They continued to the Water Gate on the east.
passages.original: וְעַל֩ שַׁ֨עַר הָעַ֜יִן וְנֶגְדָּ֗ם עָלוּ֙ עַֽל־ מַעֲלוֹת֙ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד בַּֽמַּעֲלֶ֖ה לַחוֹמָ֑ה מֵעַל֙ לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִ֔יד וְעַ֛ד שַׁ֥עַר הַמַּ֖יִם מִזְרָֽח׃

passages.text: The second thanksgiving choir proceeded to the left, and I followed it with half the people along the top of the wall, past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall, over the Gate of Ephraim, the Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel, and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. And they stopped at the Gate of the Guard.
passages.sermon:
The second thanksgiving choir walked to the left.
I followed the choir.
Half of the people went with me.
We walked on top of the wall.
We passed the Tower of the Ovens.
We continued to the Broad Wall.
We went over the Gate of Ephraim.
We passed the Jeshanah Gate.
We passed the Fish Gate.
We passed the Tower of Hananel.
We passed the Tower of the Hundred.
We went as far as the Sheep Gate.
We stopped at the Gate of the Guard.
passages.original: וְהַתּוֹדָ֧ה הַשֵּׁנִ֛ית הַהוֹלֶ֥כֶת לְמ֖וֹאל וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יהָ וַחֲצִ֨י הָעָ֜ם מֵעַ֣ל לְהַחוֹמָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ לְמִגְדַּ֣ל הַתַּנּוּרִ֔ים וְעַ֖ד הַחוֹמָ֥ה הָרְחָבָֽה׃ וּמֵעַ֣ל לְשַֽׁעַר־ אֶ֠פְרַיִם וְעַל־ שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה וְעַל־ שַׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֗ים וּמִגְדַּ֤ל חֲנַנְאֵל֙ וּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַמֵּאָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד שַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֑אן וְעָ֣מְד֔וּ בְּשַׁ֖עַר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃

passages.text: The two thanksgiving choirs then stood in the house of God, as did I, along with the half of the officials accompanying me, as well as the priests with their trumpets—Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah— and also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. Then the choirs sang out under the direction of Jezrahiah.
passages.sermon:
Two thanksgiving choirs stood in the house of God.
I stood there also.
Half of the officials stood with me.
Several priests stood there with their trumpets.
Their names were Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah.
Other priests were present.
Their names were Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer.
The singers made their voices heard.
Jezrahiah directed the singers.
passages.original: וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה שְׁתֵּ֥י הַתּוֹדֹ֖ת בְּבֵ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַאֲנִ֕י וַחֲצִ֥י הַסְּגָנִ֖ים עִמִּֽי׃ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים אֶלְיָקִ֡ים מַעֲשֵׂיָ֡ה מִ֠נְיָמִין מִיכָיָ֧ה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֛י זְכַרְיָ֥ה חֲנַנְיָ֖ה בַּחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃ וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֨ה וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר וְעֻזִּ֛י וִֽיהוֹחָנָ֥ן וּמַלְכִּיָּ֖ה וְעֵילָ֣ם וָעָ֑זֶר וַיַּשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וְיִֽזְרַחְיָ֖ה הַפָּקִֽיד׃

passages.text: On that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard from afar.
passages.sermon:
The people of Jerusalem offered great sacrifices on that day.
They rejoiced.
God gave them great joy.
The women rejoiced.
The children rejoiced.
People far away heard the joy in Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ בַיּוֹם־ הַ֠הוּא זְבָחִ֨ים גְּדוֹלִ֜ים וַיִּשְׂמָ֗חוּ כִּ֤י הָאֱלֹהִים֙ שִׂמְּחָם֙ שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וְגַ֧ם הַנָּשִׁ֛ים וְהַיְלָדִ֖ים שָׂמֵ֑חוּ וַתִּשָּׁמַ֛ע שִׂמְחַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מֵרָחֽוֹק׃

passages.text: And on that same day men were appointed over the rooms that housed the supplies, contributions, firstfruits, and tithes. The portions specified by the Law for the priests and Levites were gathered into these storerooms from the fields of the villages, because Judah rejoiced over the priests and Levites who were serving.
passages.sermon:
On that same day, leaders appointed men to oversee the storerooms.
These storerooms held supplies, contributions, firstfruits, and tithes.
The people brought these portions from the fields of the villages.
The Law required these portions for the priests and Levites.
Judah rejoiced over the priests and Levites who served.
passages.original: וַיִּפָּקְד֣וּ בַיּוֹם֩ הַה֨וּא אֲנָשִׁ֜ים עַל־ הַנְּשָׁכ֗וֹת לָא֨וֹצָר֥וֹת לַתְּרוּמוֹת֮ לָרֵאשִׁ֣ית וְלַמַּֽעַשְׂרוֹת֒ לִכְנ֨וֹס בָּהֶ֜ם לִשְׂדֵ֤י הֶעָרִים֙ מְנָא֣וֹת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם כִּ֚י שִׂמְחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה עַל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְעַל־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם הָעֹמְדִֽים׃

passages.text: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, along with the singers and gatekeepers, as David and his son Solomon had prescribed.
passages.sermon:
The priests and Levites served God.
They kept the duties of purification.
The singers served.
The gatekeepers served.
David gave commands for these duties.
Solomon, David’s son, also gave commands for these duties.
The people followed the commands of David and Solomon.
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֞וּ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶם֙ וּמִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַֽטָּהֳרָ֔ה וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים כְּמִצְוַ֥ת דָּוִ֖יד שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there were directors for the singers and for the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel long ago.
Asaph was a leader in Israel at that time.
In those days, they appointed directors for the singers.
These directors led the people in singing.
The singers sang songs of praise to God.
They also sang songs of thanksgiving to God.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ בִימֵ֥י דָוִ֛יד וְאָסָ֖ף מִקֶּ֑דֶם רֹאשׁ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וְשִׁיר־ תְּהִלָּ֥ה וְהֹד֖וֹת לֵֽאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: So in the days of Zerubbabel and Nehemiah, all Israel contributed the daily portions for the singers and gatekeepers. They also set aside daily portions for the Levites, and the Levites set aside daily portions for the descendants of Aaron.
passages.sermon:
In the days of Zerubbabel and Nehemiah, all Israel gave daily portions.
They gave these portions to the singers.
They gave these portions to the gatekeepers.
The people set aside daily portions for the Levites.
The Levites set aside daily portions for the descendants of Aaron.
passages.original: וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֩ בִּימֵ֨י זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וּבִימֵ֣י נְחֶמְיָ֗ה נֹֽתְנִ֛ים מְנָי֛וֹת הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֖ים דְּבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֑וֹ וּמַקְדִּשִׁים֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֖ים לִבְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃פ
